correctness.rationale: Proof by complete splitting of cyclic shift over algebraic closure. Nonresonant local factors split into z and z^-1 eigendirections. Resonant local factors satisfy (t-zeta)^2=epsilon^2 t/z and have exactly the stated Jordan sizes, yielding the arithmetic defect in each fixed space. Order and Moebius inversion then follow. Two independently structured stdlib checkers validated 1,235 rank tests and 103,788 enumerated states; these are supplementary, not a universal proof.

value.rationale: All fixed-point populations and primitive orbit populations are canonical dynamical invariants of the reversible nearest-neighbor finite-field wave, for arbitrary field size and simple-cycle length. The even/odd ring order collapse in characteristic two is a non-obvious structural boundary explained by Jordan degeneracy, not a decorative low-n constant. This resolves the full natural census instead of one parameter slice.
